h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ujjain

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ujjain

items.pText: Ujjain receives visitors at the Mahakaleshwar temple all year, and during the Simhastha Kumbh the numbers rise many times over. Gardens, dharamshalas and public spaces here see children from all over the country, and the equipment has to take that use. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for parks, trusts, schools and colonies in Ujjain at our factory in Vasai East, about 520 km away.

The city is on the Malwa plateau in western Madhya Pradesh, close to Indore, with hot summers, a monsoon from June to September and cool winters. Delivery is by road, and a dealer in central India or our own installation team puts the equipment up. Share the size of the space, photos and an idea of how many children use it on a busy day. We will plan sturdy pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Equipment for public spaces with heavy footfall

c: In a space used by many visiting families, choose fewer, stronger pieces over many small ones. Grout every post into concrete so nothing can be shifted, and avoid loose parts that can be carried away. A
or a multi play station takes a group of children at once and keeps queues moving.

items.q: What equipment holds up in a garden used by many visitors?
items.a: Grouted, galvanised structures with roto-moulded parts and few loose fittings. Multi play stations and merry-go-rounds take groups at once, which keeps queues short on busy days.

items.q: How often should a busy public playground be checked?
items.a: Weekly during busy seasons. Check bolts, seats, chains and the surface under each piece, and call our after-sales team if anything is damaged.
